gl:definition.gl:content: implementation-independent potential of a component to achieve an effect within a domain

gl:notes.gl:content: Capabilities can be orchestrated and structured hierarchically.
Capabilities can be made executable via services.
The impact manifests itself in a measurable effect within the physical world.

gl:ref.gl:source: IDTA-01001-3.2:2026 (Specification of the Asset Administration Shell — Part 1: Metamodel)
